page: Microsoft Azure DC4es_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEV6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage solutions, though it is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no integrated GPUs present on this server, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the DC4es_v6 offers a dedicated hardware profile suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of local storage. Given its 4 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of memory, this instance is positioned for general-purpose workloads, small-scale databases, and memory-conscious applications that utilize network-attached Premium Storage.
